name: Gushers
summary: **Gushers** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Cookie Fam Genetics]] in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. A cross of [[gelato-41|Gelato #41]] and [[triangle-kush|Triangle Kush]], it placed in the outdoor category at the 2018 Emerald Cup. It is also sold as White Gushers.

origin.place: San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA
